## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky30

- [PR #37](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/37): Cache the hash of the immutable target set in `TestsForTargetPatternKey`. Repeated Skyframe lookups and reverse-dependency updates no longer recompute the hash across every label. Equality and graph invalidation are unchanged.
- [PR #43](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/43): Skip incremental symlink tasks for main-repository packages when eager symlink planting found no case conflicts. Avoid allocating future-array storage or joining futures when no tasks are submitted. External repository root registration, required symlinks, and completion/error handling are unchanged.

### Validation

Passed uncached on Linux remote execution: `LoadingPhaseRunnerTest`, `TargetPatternPhaseKeyTest`, `TestSuiteExpansionKeyCodecTest`, `SkymeldBuildIntegrationTest`, `SkymeldOutputServiceBuildIntegrationTest`, `SymlinkForestTest`, and `cache_probe_test`. All 21 immutable-release publication checks passed.

### Release publication

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before publication. The immutable release includes SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
